ideas.idea: Add address, directions and opening hours text to the Visit page so it matches its description
ideas.why: The visit page description promises directions but the body only gives a brief line on opening days.

ideas.idea: List all the 40+ varieties on the Varieties page rather than naming two
ideas.why: The page claims over forty varieties but names only two, so the content doesn't back up the claim.

ideas.idea: Give each variety its own page and add it to the sitemap
ideas.why: Individual addressable pages for each variety would give crawlers and users specific URLs to find and link to.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite structured data in the layout
ideas.why: The deliberate choices state that having no JSON-LD is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Label the Visit details with LocalBusiness structured data
ideas.why: It relies on adding JSON-LD, which is explicitly not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add a site-wide default title and description in the layout
ideas.why: All current pages set their own metadata, so this is only a safety net against future mistakes.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
ideas.why: This is accurate but standard advice with a small effect on a 3-URL site.

ideas.idea: Add internal links between home, Varieties and Visit in page content
ideas.why: The nav already links all three pages, so in-body links add little.

ideas.idea: Keep the site URL in a single shared constant
ideas.why: This is a maintainability tip that doesn't change how people or machines find the site.

ideas.idea: Make descriptions more specific by mentioning the Herefordshire orchard
ideas.why: The Varieties and Visit descriptions don't say who the site is or where, which the home page does.
